issues.title: Reconcile consolidated ADP Assistant / Chief-of-Staff design and delivery plans
issues.change: Remaining architecture/product contracts and single foundation qualification ownership remain open.

issues.title: [COS-E1] EPIC: ADP Assistant / Personal Chief of Staff — product, foundation and runtime
issues.change: Canonical product epic with runtime/host waves, preserved completed foundation and explicit remaining product scope.

issues.title: [COS-S01] Add a crew-pod workload class for persistent chat sessions (admission, egress, narrow IRSA)
issues.change: Owner EBS PVC and admission/helper credential boundary; ephemeral isolation retained.

issues.title: [COS-S05] Package Kiro Crew into the crew-pod image with rendered config and headless start
issues.change: Unmodified upstream Crew profile, native configuration and retained home; no source patches.

issues.title: [COS-S08] Back up and restore Crew through verified S3 archives and checkpoint metadata
issues.change: Replaces Crew event sink with verified archive/manifest, checkpoint metadata/API, atomic latest pointer, external helper and retention.

issues.title: [COS-S09] Lease one crew executor per user across all persistent sessions
issues.change: One active owner writer, generation fencing and checkpoint-aware handoff.

issues.title: [COS-S13] Add "Open my Crew" to the ADP UI with on-demand pod wake and readiness
issues.change: Truthful restore and sync UI separate from AgentCore availability; native dashboard retained.

issues.title: [COS-S06] Bridge ADP turns into the Kiro Crew session and consolidate memory on stop
issues.change: Retained session map, native consolidation and verified final checkpoint before normal stop.

issues.title: [COS-S07] Provide shared AgentCore user memory through the ADP gateway
issues.change: Replaces Crew event store with gateway AgentCore capture/recall/management across unchanged assistants.

issues.title: [COS-EV1] Repository evaluation — runtime contracts, inventory and foundation drivers
issues.change: Repository contract/inventory/deployment/driver evidence; no cloud proof inferred from fixtures.

issues.title: [COS-EV2] Repository evaluation — gateway memory, Crew checkpoints and owner sessions
issues.change: Replaces fork/event checks with gateway memory, checkpoint failure/retry, scope and native container recovery.

issues.title: [COS-EV3] Repository evaluation — private Crew dashboard and EKS access
issues.change: Dashboard restore readiness and sync status repository evidence.

issues.title: [COS-EVL] Live qualification — assistant runtime and managed EC2 hosting (EP-01–EP-06)
issues.change: Live EP-02/06 memory/recovery across assistants and targets, with actual service receipts and cleanup.

issues.title: [COS-S14] Crew target abstraction and executor inventory: target_kind on leases, crew_executors table, resolver
issues.change: Stable owner/generation contract upstream; #7202 owns checkpoint migration and latest pointer.

issues.title: [COS-S15] Install and integrate the EC2 assistant on the managed Dev Box service
issues.change: External helper and exact-version restore on managed EC2; cross-target and stale-disk coverage.

issues.title: [COS-EV4] Repository evaluation — Dev Box service and EC2 assistant installation
issues.change: Managed installer, checkpoint/AgentCore integration and host service repository checks.
